slides.title: RiskON Orchestra
slides.purpose: Frame the product promise in one memorable sentence.
slides.speaker_key_message: Many agents investigate. Evidence decides. Humans approve.
slides.supporting_line: A risk-adaptive suitability assistant that answers, clarifies, abstains, routes and evolves safely.
slides.footer: Synthetic local demonstration — no real client or Bank data

slides.title: Finding the page is not the same as finding the answer
slides.purpose: Make the business problem concrete before introducing the solution.
slides.speaker_key_message: The challenge is not retrieval alone. It is deciding when the evidence permits an answer.

cards.label: Front Office
cards.body: Time is lost searching across fragmented guidance.

cards.label: Experts
cards.body: Repetitive documented questions crowd out complex cases.

cards.label: The Bank
cards.body: A plausible but unsupported answer is more dangerous than no answer.

slides.bottom_message: The challenge is not retrieval alone. It is deciding when the evidence permits an answer.

slides.title: One question. Four disciplined outcomes.
slides.purpose: Show that the product is a decision system, not only a search box.
slides.source_label: Questions & Evaluation Set; RiskON Challenge Guidance, slide 7
slides.speaker_key_message: We separate “I need more context” from “the available knowledge cannot answer this.”

outcomes.label: ABSTAIN
outcomes.body: Evidence is absent, conflicting or out of scope.

outcomes.label: ROUTE
outcomes.body: Human judgment is required; select the right support function.

slides.bottom_message: We separate “I need more context” from “the available knowledge cannot answer this.”

slides.title: Risk-adaptive orchestration — not agent majority voting
slides.purpose: Explain the bounded architecture and its safety rule.
slides.source_label: RiskON bonus areas: multi-agent architecture, adaptive retrieval, self-verification and explainability
slides.speaker_key_message: One unresolved material objection blocks an unsafe answer.
slides.core_rule: One unresolved material objection blocks an unsafe answer.
slides.bottom_note: Easy questions activate zero workers. Only context-sensitive questions use the full Orchestra.

slides.title: Live demonstration
slides.purpose: Hand the audience from the narrative to the frozen local demo.
slides.speaker_key_message: Do not trust the answer. Try to disprove it.
steps: Answer one explicit question with zero agents
Challenge a context-sensitive answer from independent angles
Show how verified expert feedback becomes governed knowledge
slides.large_line: Do not trust the answer. Try to disprove it.

slides.title: The system learns — but never self-authorises
slides.purpose: Show how expert feedback becomes governed knowledge without silent policy drift.
slides.source_label: M5B governed evolution and Policy CI outputs
slides.speaker_key_message: An expert resolution is evidence for a proposed change, not an automatic change to authoritative knowledge.
slides.core_message: An expert resolution is evidence for a proposed change, not an automatic change to authoritative knowledge.

slides.title: We evaluate the decisions the system makes — including not answering
slides.purpose: Replace marketing claims with evaluator-sourced proof points.
slides.source_label: Current local ER-B dashboard and evaluator outputs
slides.speaker_key_message: The metrics are read from the current generated evaluator outputs, not typed into the deck source.
slides.metric_footer: Current demonstration: synthetic, local and deterministic

slides.title: More self-service for routine questions. More expert time for the cases that matter.
slides.purpose: Close the main story with practical value for the operating model.
slides.source_label: RiskON Challenge Guidance and prototype outcomes
slides.speaker_key_message: RiskON knows why it may answer, why it must not, and how the organisation can safely learn.

pillars.label: Front Office
pillars.body: Faster evidence-backed guidance at the point of need.

pillars.label: Risk & Compliance
pillars.body: Fewer repetitive questions; richer case capsules for complex cases.

pillars.label: The organisation
pillars.body: Visible knowledge gaps and controlled improvement over time.

slides.final_statement: RiskON does not simply know the answer or know who knows. It knows why it may answer, why it must not, and how the organisation can safely learn.

slides.title: Local first by design
slides.purpose: Make the confidentiality and no-egress boundary visible.

slides.title: What this prototype proves — and what it does not
slides.purpose: Set honest limits before questions and protect trust.
slides.source_label: Observed prototype boundary and event-day acceptance contract
slides.speaker_key_message: The orchestration and worker isolation are real; the current backend is deterministic and model-agnostic.
does_not_prove: Accuracy on the unseen event corpus
Reliable interpretation of every image-only source
critical_wording: The orchestration and worker isolation are real.
The current worker backend is deterministic for reproducibility and confidential-data safety.
It is model-agnostic, but this demo does not claim a model-driven autonomous swarm.
